fields.name: Tech
fields.description: Technology, computing, software engineering, and digital systems.

domains.name: Cybersecurity
domains.description: Protecting systems, networks, data, and applications from digital attacks.

subjects.name: Web Security
subjects.description: Defending web applications against common exploits, injection vulnerabilities, and authentication flaws.

topics.title: SQL Injection (SQLi)
topics.notes: Covers how unvalidated user inputs allow attackers to interfere with backend database queries. Explains parameterized queries as the primary defense.
topics.why_it_matters: SQL injection remains one of the most critical web application vulnerabilities, leading to severe data breaches if left unmitigated.

topics.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
topics.notes: Details Stored, Reflected, and DOM-based XSS vulnerabilities. Explores Content Security Policy (CSP) and context-aware HTML output encoding.
topics.why_it_matters: XSS allows malicious scripts to run in victims' browsers, compromising cookies, session tokens, and sensitive client data.

topics.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
topics.notes: Explains how unauthorized commands are transmitted from a trusted user. Discusses anti-CSRF tokens and SameSite cookie attributes.
topics.why_it_matters: CSRF exploits ambient credentials (like cookies), forcing authenticated users to unintentionally perform sensitive actions.

topics.title: CORS & Browser Origin Security
topics.notes: Comprehensive breakdown of Same-Origin Policy (SOP), preflight OPTIONS requests, and proper Access-Control header configurations.
topics.why_it_matters: Misconfigured CORS headers can inadvertently expose private APIs to malicious third-party origins.

subjects.name: Applied Cryptography
subjects.description: Mathematical principles and engineering practices for securing communication and sensitive data.

topics.title: Symmetric vs Asymmetric Encryption
topics.notes: Compares AES and ChaCha20 symmetric ciphers with RSA and ECC public-key cryptosystems, along with practical performance trade-offs.
topics.why_it_matters: Modern secure communication relies on a hybrid model using asymmetric cryptography for key exchange and symmetric ciphers for bulk data.

topics.title: Cryptographic Hash Functions & Digital Signatures
topics.notes: Examines collision resistance in SHA-256 and SHA-3, salt/pepper hashing for passwords (bcrypt/Argon2), and digital signature verification.
topics.why_it_matters: Ensures message integrity and authenticates identity without ever revealing private credentials or raw passwords.

topics.title: The TLS 1.3 Handshake Protocol
topics.notes: Step-by-step walkthrough of TLS 1.3 key negotiation, Diffie-Hellman ephemeral exchange, and perfect forward secrecy.
topics.why_it_matters: TLS is the backbone of HTTPS and internet confidentiality across all web and mobile applications.

domains.name: Artificial Intelligence
domains.description: Creating intelligent systems, machine learning models, and cognitive architectures.

subjects.name: Machine Learning Foundations
subjects.description: Core concepts, learning paradigms, and mathematical models that power modern AI systems.

topics.title: Supervised Learning & Regression
topics.notes: Introduction to labeled training data, linear regression, cost functions, gradient descent, and evaluation metrics (MSE, R2).
topics.why_it_matters: Forms the foundation of predictive modeling across business forecasting, diagnostics, and classification tasks.

topics.title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff & Regularization
topics.notes: Detailed treatment of underfitting, overfitting, cross-validation, and L1 (Lasso) / L2 (Ridge) penalty terms.
topics.why_it_matters: Crucial for building models that generalize accurately to unseen real-world data rather than memorizing training data.

topics.title: Artificial Neural Networks & Backpropagation
topics.notes: Perceptrons, activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid), computational graphs, chain rule calculus, and weights updating.
topics.why_it_matters: Deep learning architectures power contemporary computer vision, speech synthesis, and large language models.

topics.title: Attention Mechanisms & Transformers
topics.notes: Self-attention mechanism, positional encodings, multi-head attention, and transformer encoder-decoder architectures.
topics.why_it_matters: The core breakthrough behind state-of-the-art generative AI systems, modern NLP, and multimodal AI.

domains.name: Data Science
domains.description: Extracting actionable insights from structured and unstructured datasets using statistical methods.

subjects.name: Data Analysis with Python
subjects.description: Practical data manipulation, cleaning, and exploratory data analysis using industry-standard libraries.

topics.title: Exploratory Data Analysis with Pandas
topics.notes: Techniques for filtering, grouping, aggregating, handling missing values, and reshaping tabular datasets.
topics.why_it_matters: Real-world data is messy; over 70% of a data scientist's time is spent wrangling and understanding data structures.

topics.title: Effective Data Storytelling & Visualization
topics.notes: Color theory, chart selection guidelines, decluttering visuals, and communicating statistical findings clearly to stakeholders.
topics.why_it_matters: Data insights provide no value unless they can be communicated clearly to drive decision-making.

domains.name: Cloud Computing
domains.description: On-demand computing resources, containerized workloads, serverless services, and cloud architecture.

subjects.name: Cloud Infrastructure & Containers
subjects.description: Modern infrastructure paradigms including Docker containers, Kubernetes orchestration, and cloud primitives.

topics.title: Docker Containers & Images
topics.notes: Understanding containerization vs virtualization, Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and container networking.
topics.why_it_matters: Ensures environment parity across local development, testing, and production servers.

topics.title: Kubernetes Architecture & Pod Lifecycle
topics.notes: Control plane components, worker nodes, Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress controllers, and automated scaling.
topics.why_it_matters: Kubernetes is the de facto operating system for enterprise-scale distributed cloud applications.

domains.name: Programming Languages
domains.description: Language paradigms, memory safety, compilers, and modern idiomatic programming practices.

subjects.name: Modern JavaScript & TypeScript
subjects.description: Deep dive into execution context, event loop, asynchronous patterns, and static type safety.

topics.title: The JavaScript Event Loop & Concurrency
topics.notes: Call stack, Web APIs, microtask queue, macrotask queue, Promises, and async/await mechanics.
topics.why_it_matters: Mastering asynchronous flow prevents UI freezes, race conditions, and unhandled promise rejections in web apps.

topics.title: TypeScript Generics & Utility Types
topics.notes: Generic constraints, type inference, conditional types, Mapped Types, and built-in helpers (Pick, Omit, Partial).
topics.why_it_matters: Allows developers to build reusable, resilient libraries with strict compile-time guarantees.

domains.name: Full Stack Development
domains.description: End-to-end web architecture from accessible frontend interfaces to scalable backend APIs.

subjects.name: Web Application Architecture
subjects.description: System design for web applications, state management, caching, and database design.

topics.title: RESTful API Design & HTTP Semantics
topics.notes: HTTP methods, status code semantics, idempotent operations, pagination strategies, and API versioning patterns.
topics.why_it_matters: Well-architected APIs are intuitive, stable for client integrations, and easy to maintain over time.

topics.title: Relational Database Indexing & Query Tuning
topics.notes: B-Tree indexes, composite indexes, query execution plans (EXPLAIN), and table scan mitigation.
topics.why_it_matters: Poor indexing is the most common cause of catastrophic performance degradation as data volume grows.

domains.name: DevOps
domains.description: Automating software delivery, infrastructure management, continuous testing, and observability.

subjects.name: Continuous Integration & Delivery (CI/CD)
subjects.description: Automated pipelines for testing, linting, packaging, and deploying software reliably.

topics.title: Building Reliable CI/CD Pipelines
topics.notes: Trigger mechanisms, stage parallelization, automated smoke tests, rollback strategies, and immutable artifacts.
topics.why_it_matters: Enables teams to ship high-quality updates rapidly and with confidence, reducing downtime.

fields.name: Non-Tech
fields.description: Disciplines from humanities, business, economics, cognitive psychology, and visual design.

domains.name: Design & UX
domains.description: User experience research, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and cognitive accessibility.

subjects.name: Interaction Design Principles
subjects.description: Foundational ergonomics, mental models, feedback loops, and usability heuristics for human-computer interfaces.

topics.title: Jakob Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics
topics.notes: Walkthrough of visibility of system status, match between system and real world, error prevention, and recognition over recall.
topics.why_it_matters: Provides a universally respected framework for spotting usability issues before user testing even begins.

topics.title: Visual Hierarchy, Spacing & Typography
topics.notes: Scale, contrast, whitespace, grouping (Gestalt laws), and typographic scales to guide human eye scanning.
topics.why_it_matters: Users scan web interfaces in F-shaped and Z-shaped patterns; clear hierarchy ensures immediate comprehension.

domains.name: Cognitive Science & Psychology
domains.description: Understanding human perception, memory consolidation, mental models, and decision-making.

subjects.name: The Science of Learning
subjects.description: Evidence-based techniques for mastering complex topics, long-term retention, and deliberate practice.

topics.title: Spaced Repetition & Active Retrieval
topics.notes: Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, Leitner system, active recall testing effect, and interval scheduling.
topics.why_it_matters: Active retrieval produces significantly higher long-term retention compared to passive rereading or highlighting.

topics.title: Cognitive Load Theory in Knowledge Acquisition
topics.notes: Intrinsic, extraneous, and germane cognitive load; working memory limitations; and chunking strategies.
topics.why_it_matters: Helps learners and educators structure information so working memory is not overwhelmed.

domains.name: Business Strategy & Product
domains.description: Frameworks for validating market needs, building sustainable products, and strategic execution.

subjects.name: Product Discovery & Management
subjects.description: Identifying customer problems, hypothesis testing, unit economics, and prioritizing product features.

topics.title: Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) Framework
topics.notes: Focusing on the underlying progress a customer desires rather than demographic traits or superficial feature requests.
topics.why_it_matters: Products fail when they build features customers requested but that do not solve their core underlying struggle.

fields.name: Interdisciplinary
fields.description: Subjects connecting computing, biological systems, policy, economics, and ethical governance.

domains.name: Tech Ethics & Digital Rights
domains.description: Moral philosophies, algorithmic accountability, data sovereignty, and technological governance.

subjects.name: AI Ethics & Algorithmic Fairness
subjects.description: Analyzing bias in automated decision systems, transparency, privacy rights, and responsible AI guidelines.

topics.title: Detecting & Mitigating Algorithmic Bias
topics.notes: Disparate impact, representation disparities in training corpora, demographic parity, and ethical auditing methods.
topics.why_it_matters: Automated scoring systems can amplify historic societal discrimination if unchecked.

domains.name: Bioinformatics & Computational Biology
domains.description: Applying algorithmic computation and statistical modeling to biological sequences and molecular structures.

subjects.name: Sequence Analysis & Genomics
subjects.description: Dynamic programming for sequence alignment, BLAST heuristics, and genome variant discovery.

topics.title: Pairwise Sequence Alignment (Needleman-Wunsch & Smith-Waterman)
topics.notes: Global vs local sequence alignment using dynamic programming matrices, scoring schemas, and gap penalty formulations.
topics.why_it_matters: Fundamental to identifying evolutionary relationships, functional gene domains, and disease-causing mutations.

fields.name: Miscellaneous
fields.description: Productivity systems, academic research methodologies, and meta-learning disciplines.

domains.name: Personal Knowledge Management
domains.description: Systems, taxonomies, and digital tools for collecting, organizing, and synthesizing insights over a lifetime.

subjects.name: PKM Architectures & Note-Taking
subjects.description: Systematic frameworks for personal knowledge organization, bidirectional linking, and lifelong learning.

topics.title: The Zettelkasten Method & Atomic Notes
topics.notes: Niklas Luhmann's slip-box system: literature notes vs permanent notes, atomic concepts, and emergent connections.
topics.why_it_matters: Transforms passive bookmarking into active intellectual compounding and synthesis.

topics.title: CODE & PARA Organization Frameworks
topics.notes: Capture, Organize, Distill, Express (CODE) and Projects, Areas, Resources, Archives (PARA) organizational taxonomy.
topics.why_it_matters: Eliminates digital clutter and aligns saved information with actionable outcomes and projects.

learning_paths.title: Web Application Security Specialist
learning_paths.description: A curated sequence covering client-side vulnerabilities, backend injection flaws, and transport-layer security.

learning_paths.title: Modern Full-Stack Engineering
learning_paths.description: Build high-performance, robust web applications from frontend concurrency to API architecture and database indexing.

learning_paths.title: Meta-Learning & Knowledge Mastery
learning_paths.description: Master evidence-based study techniques, active recall, cognitive load management, and personal knowledge systems.
